bottleneck.summary: Use AGM001146456 branch: no path negatives, +.0841…+.1294 lambda and Tc+1.837 K against Nb2HfTa. Fine force .04756/stress .429 GPa are explicit refinements. AGM001233891 has four path negatives (-22.6498 at x5.260949) and is retained grade2; source geometry branch selection is physical and not chosen by larger Tc. One composition group only.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 2.3911261376491538e-05 eV/Å, pressure -0.001 GPa; fine force 0.047556156443455705 eV/Å, pressure -0.022 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Hf-to-Zr minority-site construction in ZrNb2Ta. coupled chemistry/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare saved branch-specific strain/mode evidence, keeping target146456 versus its exact Hf parent. Favorable: stable branch retains gain under fine geometry uncertainty; adverse: phase/strain loses it; ambiguous: branch association incomplete.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
